0.original: The amiable maiden appears suddenly concerned.

48.original: I will never leave my lady's side again!

49.original: All this talk of relying on the bonded, and I haven't given a thought as to what your duties might be. I hope I haven't interrupted your work unduly?

50.original: A tour of the city, is it? Then you really must visit the Beehive─it's always buzzing with activity! Ahem, local humor...

51.original: Anyway, a lady by the name of Tista-Bie usually has her seat near the entrance. She will gladly speak with you on any number of topics, assuming you find yourself on her good side!

52.original: I think you will find the Beehive is far more diverting than watching me pick out new curtains for the parlor!

53.original: Welcome to the Beehive, my little drone. Seeking the sting of excitement to liven up your day?

54.original: ...Hm hm, I can tell at a glance when folk are new to our happy colony. It's the nervous fluttering, you see─always gives them away.

55.original: Why don't we play some cards to set you at your ease, eh? A quick game of “High or Low”─it's simply a matter of guessing who has the bigger hand.

56.original: If you win, I'll grant you a single favor...within reason, of course. Interested?

57.original: Ready for a game of “High or Low”, then?

62.original: “High or Low” is a guessing game. You must decide whether the total of your three cards is higher or lower than the total of your opponent's cards.

63.original: The deck holds nine cards, with the pictures printed thereon representing the numbers one through nine. Each number appears only once in the deck, so there are no repeats.

64.original: If you guess correctly, then you win the match. If both totals are the same, then another hand is dealt.

65.original: Oh? Well, you know where to find me if you want to play a hand or two.

66.original: Good for you! No time like the present, I say!

67.original: Three cards for you, three cards for me. You flip one of yours over, and I flip two of mine.

68.original: Now, what's your call? Will your total be higher or lower than mine?

72.original: You're going with “low,” then? Right, let's see what we've got...

73.original: You're going with “high,” then? Right, let's see what we've got...

74.original: My cards add up to <hex:022003E80203>. And you have...

77.original: Hm... Usually I'd concede defeat at this point, but what do you say to a rematch? One more win, then we'll talk about that favor.

78.original: Aw... Sorry, honeybee, but this match goes to me.

80.original: That's what I like to hear. Let me shuffle the deck...

81.original: Had enough for now? Fine, fine─I'll be sitting right here should the mood strike you.

82.original: Oho, it seems we came out equal. But as lovely a coincidence as that may be, we still need a clear winner...

83.original: Another match of “High or Low”? Come now, little honeybee, we all need our diversions.

84.original: That's the spirit! Let me sort out the deck...

85.original: Well, well, would you look at that. I think you've got a knack for this, newcomer.

86.original: Congratulations! Victory is yours...as is the prize I promised.

87.original: Oh dear, looks like this match goes to me.

88.original: Come whisper in my ear, then, and don't be shy. Tell ol' Tista what she can do for you.

89.original: ...That's all? How delightfully wholesome. But if knowledge is what you want, then that is what you shall have.

90.original: In my humble estimation, the most wondrous thing about this town is how safe we are from the sin eaters.

91.original: They say Lord Vauthry was born with the power to command them─which means no Eulmoran need ever raise a weapon in defense of the city.

92.original: ...Was that the kind of thing you wished to know? If your itch still needs scratching, you might get a few words out of Atharn over there. There's naught that merry sot likes more than the sound of his own voice.

93.original: Whassat? New to Eulmore, you say?

94.original: Gahaha! Only just arrived and already you're looking to peel away the layers of mystery. Oh, I'm all for chatting, but you need to slow down and <hex:021A020203>enjoy<hex:021A020103> life, my friend!

95.original: I tell you what: you hop up on stage and give us a dance first, and <hex:021A020203>then<hex:021A020103> we can have our little talk!

96.original: Go on, there's plenty of room up there! Give us your best shimmies and shakes!

97.original: (-Atharn-)That's the way! Dance like there's no tomorrow!

98.original: <whistle> Now <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> was a show! You're welcome to clamber up on stage any time you like!

99.original: So...what was it you wanted to ask me? Ah, yes, something about our fair city. Well, I can tell you it wasn't always so peaceful as it is today.

100.original: The Eulmoran Army may be the very essence of military might, but even our forces saw grievous losses in the war against the sin eaters.

101.original: Things changed for us, oh, around twenty years ago now, when the old ruler's son came to power!

102.original: He's got this way with the eaters, you see─turns them docile as house cats. I wouldn't be exaggerating to say they've become something of an ally to Eulmore. No longer an enemy to be feared.

103.original: And yet elsewhere, there are still fools who insist on fighting their losing battles... Pah! A toast to Lord Vauthry!

104.original: You've gained a preliminary sense of the city. The Chais─and Alphinaud─will be expecting your return.

105.original: Hm...? Ah, yes, the assistant. Was there something?

106.original: Oh, you've returned from your jaunt around the city? So soon?

107.original: You needn't have hurried back─young Alphinaud has yet to put brush to canvas.

108.original: One cannot rush good art, I'm told. Or good artists, apparently...

110.original: I've put together an ensemble out of the garments you chose. Is this satisfactory?

111.original: Oh, goodness gracious me! That last outfit was precious, but this makes you look positively dashing!

112.original: You truly are a handsome boy! However am I to decide!?

115.original: I don't recall this part of the artistic process...

116.original: Exactly! The lad is an artist, dearest, not a dress-up doll. It's about time we set him to work for the reason we called him here!

117.original: ...Must we? I do love a good painting, but I thought since we were enjoying ourselves so thoroughly...

118.original: Well, I'd not─ That is to say, as long as you...

119.original: Ugh. Just...make sure you give the lad time to prepare. We know who'll be upset if he's not ready to paint at a moment's notice.

120.original: Whatever you say, darling. So! Shall we pick out some jewelry, next!?
